name: Rangbazz: The story of Deva
overview: Rangbazz is a gripping cinematic journey that explores the themes of power, struggle, and redemption. Directed by Divyank Pandey and produced under the banner of Action Film Industry, the story delves into the life of Deva, a man caught between his principles and the harsh realities of the world. With high-octane action and deep emotional undertones, the film showcases a new era of storytelling from the heart of Bilaspur.
